lines.gurmukhi: ਲਿਖੇ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: likhe baajhahu surat naahee bol bol gavaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Without pre-ordained destiny, understanding is not attained; talking and babbling, one wastes his life away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਬਹੀਐ ਭਲਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਲਿਖਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jithai jaai baheeai bhalaa kaheeai surat sabad likhaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Wherever you go and sit, speak well, and write the Word of the Shabad in your consciousness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੂੜਿ ਵਿਗਾੜਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਨਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa kooR vigaaR kaahe naaeeai ||1||
lines.translation: Why bother to wash the body which is polluted by falsehood? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਮੈ ਕਹਿਆ ਕਹਣੁ ਜਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਕਹਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa mai kahiaa kahan jaa tujhai kahaaiaa ||
lines.translation: When I have spoken, I spoke as You made me speak.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit har kaa naam merai man bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is pleasing to my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਦੂਖਿ ਡੇਰਾ ਢਾਹਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam meethaa manahi laagaa dookh deraa dhaahiaa ||
lines.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, seems so sweet to my mind; it has destroyed the dwelling of pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਆਇ ਵਸਿਆ ਜਾਮਿ ਤੈ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sookh man mahi aai vasiaa jaam tai phuramaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Peace came to dwell in my mind, when You gave the Order.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadar tudh aradaas meree ji(n)n aap upaaiaa ||
lines.translation: It is Yours to bestow Your Grace, and it is mine to speak this prayer; You created Yourself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਮੈ ਕਹਿਆ ਕਹਣੁ ਜਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਕਹਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: taa mai kahiaa kahan jaa tujhai kahaaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: When I have spoken, I spoke as You made me speak. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਰੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਕਢਾਏ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaaree khasam kadhaae kirat kamaavanaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord and Master gives them their turn, according to the deeds they have done.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਆਖਿ ਝਗੜਾ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)daa kisai na aakh jhagaRaa paavanaa ||
lines.translation: Do not speak ill of others, or get involved in arguments.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਪਾਇ ਝਗੜਾ ਸੁਆਮਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੁ ਵਞਾਵਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: nah paai jhagaRaa suaam setee aap aap vanjaavanaa ||
lines.translation: Do not get into arguments with the Lord, or you shall ruin yourself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਰੀਕੀ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਆ ਰੂਆਵਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis naal sa(n)gat kar sareekee jaai kiaa rooaavanaa ||
lines.translation: If you challenge the One, with whom you must abide, you will cry in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੇਇ ਸਹਣਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਕਹਣਾ ਆਖਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਵਾਵਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo dei sahanaa manahi kahanaa aakh naahee vaavanaa ||
lines.translation: Be satisfied with what God gives you; tell your mind not to complain uselessly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਰੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਕਢਾਏ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: vaaree khasam kadhaae kirat kamaavanaa ||3||
lines.translation: The Lord and Master gives them their turn, according to the deeds they have done. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh upaaeean aap aape nadar kare ||
lines.translation: He Himself created all, and He blesses then with His Glance of Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉੜਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮਾਗੈ ਮੀਠਾ ਸਭ ਮਾਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kauRaa koi na maagai meethaa sabh maagai ||
lines.translation: No one asks for that which is bitter; everyone asks for sweets.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ਮੀਠਾ ਮੰਗਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਖਸਮ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh koi meethaa ma(n)g dekhai khasam bhaavai so kare ||
lines.translation: Let everyone ask for sweets, and behold, it is as the Lord wills.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਛੁ ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਰਣੀ ਨਾਮ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਸਮਸਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kichh pu(n)n daan anek karanee naam tul na samasare ||
lines.translation: Giving donations to charity, and performing various religious rituals are not equal to the contemplation of the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanakaa jin naam miliaa karam hoaa dhur kade ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are blessed with the Naam have had such good karma pre-ordained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sabh upaaeean aap aape nadar kare ||4||1||
lines.translation: He Himself created all, and He blesses them with His Glance of Grace. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Wadahans, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: karahu daiaa teraa naam vakhaanaa ||
lines.translation: Show mercy to me, that I may chant Your Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈਐ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh upaaeeai aap aape sarab samaanaa ||
lines.translation: You Yourself created all, and You are pervading among all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬੇ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਆਪਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਉਪਾਇ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarabe samaanaa aap toohai upaai dha(n)dhai laaeeaa ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are pervading among all, and You link them to their tasks.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਕੀਏ ਰਾਜੇ ਇਕਨਾ ਭਿਖ ਭਵਾਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik tujh hee keee raaje ikanaa bhikh bhavaaeeaa ||
lines.translation: Some, You have made kings, while others go about begging.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਤੁਝੁ ਕੀਆ ਮੀਠਾ ਏਤੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: lobh mohu tujh keeaa meethaa et bharam bhulaanaa ||
lines.translation: You have made greed and emotional attachment seem sweet; they are deluded by this delusion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਅਪਣੀ ਤਾਮਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa daiaa karahu apanee taam naam vakhaanaa ||1||
lines.translation: Be ever merciful to me; only then can I chant Your Name. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦਾ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam teraa hai saachaa sadaa mai man bhaanaa ||
lines.translation: Your Name is True, and ever pleasing to my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਇ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dookh gaiaa sukh aai samaanaa ||
lines.translation: My pains are dispelled, and I am permeated with peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaavan sur nar sughaR sujaanaa ||
lines.translation: The angels, the mortals and the silent sages sing of You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sur nar sughaR sujaan gaavahi jo terai man bhaavahe ||
lines.translation: The angels, the mortals and the silent sages sing of You; they are pleasing to Your Mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੇ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohe chetahi naahee ahilaa janam gavaavahe ||
lines.translation: Enticed by Maya, they do not remember the Lord, and they waste away their lives in vain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਮੂਲੇ ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik mooR mugadh na chetahi moole jo aaiaa tis jaanaa ||
lines.translation: Some fools and idiots never think of the Lord; whoever has come, shall have to go.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naam teraa sadaa saachaa soi mai man bhaanaa ||2||
lines.translation: Your Name is True, and ever pleasing to my mind. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਵਖਤੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa vakhat suhaavaa a(n)mrit teree baanee ||
lines.translation: Beauteous is Your time, O Lord; the Bani of Your Word is Ambrosial Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਾਉ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevak sevahi bhaau kar laagaa saau paraanee ||
lines.translation: Your servants serve You with love; these mortals are attached to Your essence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: saau praanee tinaa laagaa jinee a(n)mrit paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Those mortals are attached to Your essence, who are blessed with the Ambrosial Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਜੋਇ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਿਤ ਚੜਹਿ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam terai joi raate nit chaRahi savaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who are imbued with Your Name, prosper more and more, day by day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਜਾਮਿ ਨ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik karam dharam na hoi sa(n)jam jaam na ek pachhaanee ||
lines.translation: Some do not practice good deeds, or live righteously; nor do they practice self-restraint. They do not realize the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਖਤੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: vakhat suhaavaa sadaa teraa a(n)mrit teree baanee ||3||
lines.translation: Ever beauteous is Your time, O Lord; the Bani of Your Word is Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau balihaaree saache naavai ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to the True Name.
